events.label: Weekly jobless claims + Philly Fed survey + Conference Board LEI — first post-FOMC data
events.note: Low claims (strong labor) or a hawkish Philly Fed reading could push DXY above 100 and 30Y above 5.00% simultaneously — the dual breach that upgrades STEP_ASIDE to BEARISH. Conference Board Leading Indicators add to the data flow. Watch DXY and 30Y intraday.

events.label: US markets closed — Juneteenth; Iran formal signing ceremony in Geneva (binary catalyst)
events.note: Market closed. Warsh FOMC (June 17) delivered 9 hike dots + hawkish shock; SPX is below the 7,460 regime floor. Iran formal signing is the sole near-term circuit-breaker: success = Brent $73-75, DXY < 99.50, STEP_ASIDE reverts to HOLD by June 20 open. Failure = Brent $86-90, XLE short accelerant, STEP_ASIDE upgrades to BEARISH. Monitor Sunday evening futures for first signal.

events.label: S&P Global flash US PMIs — manufacturing + services (June)
events.note: First real-economy data of the post-FOMC cycle. Services PMI > 53 = hawkish pressure on July FOMC hike probability. Services PMI < 50 = recession concern; paradoxically dovish. Key input for July 28-29 FOMC rate hike decision.

events.label: July CPI release (est.) — most important inflation data of the summer
events.note: May CPI 4.2% triggered 9 FOMC hike dots and regime breach on June 17. June CPI (released ~July 14) is the next recalibration: if CPI holds ≥ 4.0%, hike probability for July 28-29 FOMC spikes materially; if CPI falls to ≤ 3.7%, the rate path softens and BUY regime can re-open.

events.label: Next FOMC meeting (July 28-29) — rate hike now on the table; 9 of 18 hike dots from June
events.note: Nine of 18 FOMC officials projected at least one 2026 rate hike at the June 17 meeting. A 25-bps hike (3.50-3.75% → 3.75-4.00%) at this meeting is now priced at non-trivial probability. July CPI data (~July 14) is the primary input. Rate hike = BEARISH regime confirmation. Hold = regime-dependent on interim data.

events.label: Iran-US Islamabad Declaration 60-day deadline — Hormuz full reopening + sanctions relief
events.note: Deal operational from June 19 signing; 60-day window expires August 13; Hormuz must be mine-cleared and operationally open for tanker traffic AND US sanctions relief on Iranian oil must be active by this date; failure = oil spike reversal and energy re-rally; key summer positioning watch

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First print since the June 12 IPO; the market has no public model yet, so guidance sets the multiple. Watch Starlink subscriber/ARR growth and Starship launch cadence vs. the ~$2.65T market cap implied by the $201.80 June 16 close. Binary in both directions; date approximate pending company confirmation.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs; size accordingly into the window. Exact date pending the prospectus's stated terms.
